landing.hero_subtitle: Independent development focused on survival, chaos, and unpredictable social mechanics.
landing.about_tagline: Made by Gamers, Designed by Professionals.
landing.about_text: At Campfire Studios we combine two fundamental worlds: the precision of computer engineering and a lifetime spent in front of a screen. We're a team of tech professionals who've been gamers since childhood; we carry decades of experience across every genre, mechanic, and platform imaginable. That lived experience as players is our greatest asset: we understand what frustrates the community, what creates healthy engagement, and what makes a session with friends unforgettable. Following an agile, iterative development model (Fail Fast), we turn that gamer intuition and our technical expertise into accessible, chaotic experiences with high replayability.
landing.game_description: An asymmetric multiplayer survival experience where trust is your greatest resource — and your worst weakness. Work together to keep the campfire burning, or sabotage your team from the shadows.
landing.feature1_text: Manage vital resources while darkness stalks the camp.
landing.feature2_text: Weather, creatures, and the environment change with every match.
landing.feature3_text: Find out who the infiltrator is before they destroy the defenses.
landing.prologue_tagline: A pixel-art glimpse into the story behind Camp Chaos.
landing.prologue_description: Before the campfire, there was a lighthouse. Experience the official Camp Chaos prologue: a 2D pixel-art narrative where you'll accompany Bram through his final hours before the light goes out.
landing.devlog_card1_text: We've implemented random storms that reduce visibility and gradually knock out secondary light sources. Communication matters now more than ever.
landing.devlog_card2_text: We rewrote the network layer to make sure sabotage and player actions register with no noticeable lag, even on unstable connections.
landing.devlog_card3_text: A technical breakdown of how we use 3D spatial audio to build psychological tension when players wander away from base camp.
landing.presskit_text: Are you a content creator or journalist? Download our full dossier. It includes official logos with transparent backgrounds, a technical fact sheet, and concept art.
landing.community_newsletter_text: Get exclusive notifications about Early Access dates, closed beta keys, and major development updates. Zero spam, guaranteed.
landing.community_social_text: Join us on our official channels to interact with other players, find matches, and watch the chaos unfold in real time.
